local self=require('openmw.self')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local core=require('openmw.core')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local t=-1
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during actual recovered axe pickup')
 print('WeaponDrop stock='..Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x90613))..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
 local axe=nil
 for _,obj in ipairs(nearby.items) do
  if obj.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x90613) and obj.count>0 then axe=obj;break end
 end
 if not axe then print('VilverinContinue axe axe absent');return end
 local dist=(axe.position-self.position):length()
 print('VilverinContinue axe pickup ready distance='..dist..' item='..tostring(axe)..' pos='..tostring(axe.position))
 local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0));local dv=axe.position-self.position
 local yaw=math.atan2(f.y*dv.x-f.x*dv.y,f.x*dv.x+f.y*dv.y)
 print(string.format('VilverinContinue axe walk aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(-camera.getPitch()*256+.5)))))
 if dist<45 then print('VilverinContinue axe close') end
 local origin=camera.getPosition();local target=axe.position
 for _,axis in ipairs({{util.vector3(0,1,0),util.vector3(0,0,1),util.vector3(1,0,0)}}) do
  for _,offset in ipairs({{0,-10,-20,-30,-40,10,20,30,40}}) do
   local point=axe.position+axe.rotation:apply(axis*offset)
   local hit=nearby.castRenderingRay(origin,point,{{ignore=self}})
   if hit.hitObject==axe then target=hit.hitPos;break end
  end
 end
 local view=camera.viewportToWorldVector(util.vector2(.5,.5));local dd=target-origin
 local aimYaw=math.atan2(view.y*dd.x-view.x*dd.y,view.x*dd.x+view.y*dd.y)
 local pitch=-math.atan2(dd.z,math.sqrt(dd.x*dd.x+dd.y*dd.y))
 print(string.format('VilverinContinue axe item aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(aimYaw*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor((pitch-camera.getPitch())*256+.5)))))
 local ray=nearby.castRenderingRay(origin,origin+view*2000,{{ignore=self}})
 print('VilverinContinue axe focus='..tostring(ray.hitObject)..' point='..tostring(ray.hitPos))
 if ray.hitObject==axe and ray.hitPos and (ray.hitPos-origin):length()<tonumber(core.getGMST('iMaxActivateDist')) then print('WeaponDrop focused in range') end
end}}}}
